config:
[nest]
name = "grt-supply-nest"
chain = "arbitrum-one"
chain_id = 42161
rpc_urls = [
    "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc",
]
schema_version = 2
block_timestamps = false

# L2GraphToken. Every burn and mint on Arbitrum is a `Transfer` to or from the zero address, and the
# bridge's are among them: `bridgeBurn` on a withdrawal to L1 and `bridgeMint` on a deposit. The
# network subgraph counts those as burns and mints (graph-network-subgraph#337). `BridgeBurned` and
# `BridgeMinted` carry exactly the bridge share, so the views can take it back out.
#
# Kept out of graph-allocations-nest on purpose: it is the whole GRT transfer stream, ~10M+ rows, and
# a nest cannot filter on `topics[2]`.
[[contracts]]
alias = "graph_token"
address = "0x9623063377ad1b27544c965ccd7342f7ea7e88c7"
start_block = 42449227
abi = "abis/graph-token.json"
events = [
    "Transfer",
    "BridgeMinted",
    "BridgeBurned",
]
